card.name: Words just before 'schedule'
card.fires_on: Modifier or linking words right before an expected 'schedule', such as 'normal', 'original', 'usual', 'the' or 'an', mostly in missed-dose instructions about resuming dosing.

modes.label: Resume the usual schedule
modes.description: Adjectives like normal, original or usual that come before 'dosing schedule' when a missed dose is addressed.
modes.example: Dosing should resume the next day according to the<< normal>> dosing schedule.

modes.label: Linking words before timing terms
modes.description: Small words like 'the', 'an' or 'on' where a schedule or timing word is likely next.
modes.example: Patients with chronic pain should have their dosage given on<< an>> around-the-clock basis

card.writes: It pushes the model to say the word 'schedule' next.
card.plain: It fires on the word before 'schedule', like 'original' in 'continue on the original schedule'.
